theory.heading: What Azure App Service is
theory.body: Azure App Service describes the methods and patterns used within Azure Administrator (AZ-104) to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.

theory.heading: Why Azure App Service matters
theory.body: Without Azure App Service, systems built with Azure Administrator (AZ-104) are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How Azure App Service works
theory.body: The mechanism behind Azure App Service follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of Azure App Service
theory.body: Azure App Service offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
